build_hrnet_backbone: build an HRNet backbone with configurable stages for high-resolution feature extraction
create_hrmodule: create an HRModule with multi-branch fusion layers for parallel feature processing
test_hrnet_forward: test the HRNet forward pass with random input tensors and verify multi-scale output shapes
init_hrnet_weights: initialize HRNet weights from a pretrained checkpoint or with Kaiming initialization
review_hrnet_transition_layers: review the HRNet transition layers that connect stages with different branch counts
